info.title: Products API
info.description:
RESTful API to manage products, their prices in different currencies and the currencies themselves.

**Authentication.** Every endpoint except register, login, password reset and email verification
requires a JWT. Get one from `POST /api/auth/login` and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

**Money.** Amounts are returned as strings with 2 decimals (`"150.50"`) and exchange rates with 6,
so values are never altered by floating point. Requests accept numbers or numeric strings.

**Errors.** Validation errors respond `422` with an `errors` object keyed by field; unknown resources
respond `404`; deleting a currency that products use responds `409`.
